description: LaDe M2G4RTP checkpoints trained by us with the authors' code (Yantai), re-scored on their own test split by external/rescore_m2g4rtp.py. 'as_published' compares the k-th predicted ETA with the k-th actual delivery (their metric); 'per_package' compares each package's predicted ETA with that package's actual time.

partly_cleaned_pipeline.note: courier/area statistics from training dates only, area features without true future order, busy test days kept; windows and 0-120 min input filter unchanged
